name: UnifoLM-VLA-Base
author: Unitree Robotics
task_description: Unified Vision-Language-Action policy trained by Unitree Robotics on real Unitree G1 teleoperation data across 12 manipulation tasks: Fold Towel, Stack Block, Bag Insert, Erase Board, Clean Table, Pack PencilBox, Pour Medicine, Pack PingPong, Prepare Fruit, Organize Tools, Wipe Table, and dual-robot table clean. Released 2026-03-16. Single-policy model covering all 12 tasks.
action_space: G1 whole-body: left_arm (7 DoF) + right_arm (7 DoF) + body + Dex1 gripper; end-effector poses available
provenance_notes: Verified via WebFetch of the HF model card and the GitHub repo README. Non-commercial license. This is the ONLY currently-published policy with real G1 fold training.

name: UnifoLM-VLA-Libero
author: Unitree Robotics
task_description: UnifoLM-VLA variant tuned on the LIBERO manipulation benchmark (simulation). Same architecture as UnifoLM-VLA-Base; useful for evaluation and cross-benchmark comparison, not directly for G1 deployment.
provenance_notes: Verified via WebFetch. LIBERO-tuned variant of the same Unitree VLA family. Non-commercial license.
